name: Tox21 MoleculeNet table
doi_or_citation: Wu et al., MoleculeNet: a benchmark for molecular machine learning, Chemical Science 2018, DOI 10.1039/C7SC02664A; challenge page https://tripod.nih.gov/tox21/challenge/data.jsp
version: DeepChem S3 tox21.csv.gz accessed 2026-10-19; challenge year 2014
license: MoleculeNet repository code is MIT (https://github.com/deepchem/moleculenet/blob/master/LICENSE, checked 2026-10-19). The challenge page documents public training files. A separate data-license statement for the CSV was not found on that page. EPA DSSTox catalog records an EPA data license for DSSTox broadly; that record is not a license for this CSV.
n: 7831 raw rows and 12 assay columns in the file named by the audit notebooks; this repository re-derives a curated table at runtime
endpoint_definitions: 12 in-vitro assay activities: NR-AR, NR-AR-LBD, NR-AhR, NR-Aromatase, NR-ER, NR-ER-LBD, NR-PPAR-gamma, SR-ARE, SR-ATAD5, SR-HSE, SR-MMP, SR-p53. Active=1, inactive=0, missing allowed. Not clinical toxicity.
domain_definition: Single chemical library. Domain shifts studied here are scaffold holdout and NR versus SR assay family

name: ClinicalTrials.gov study results
doi_or_citation: NIH ClinicalTrials.gov. Terms page https://clinicaltrials.gov/about-site/terms-conditions was fetched 2026-10-19 and did not yield a specific dataset-license sentence in the extracted text.
license: as aggregated by the archived v3 pipeline on 2026-09-19. Exact download snapshot hash was not preserved in the handoff.
access_date: Public NIH resource. Redistribution of the derived structure-level tables is avoided in this repository.
endpoint_definitions: 2856 adult-trial structures and 835 pediatric-trial structures in the handoff aggregate; 15 outcome rows per structure are not complete
domain_definition: Smoothed incidence (affected+0.5)/(at_risk+1), then logit. Outcomes are MedDRA-SOC or keyword groups plus ANY_OTHER_AE, ANY_SERIOUS, and MORTALITY. This is trial adverse-event incidence, not a causal risk and not a pediatric toxicity label.
redistribution_status: Adult domain: interventional trials with parseable minimum age at least 18. Pediatric domain: parseable maximum age at most 17. Mixed-age trials excluded. Primary transfer subset: pediatric structures whose InChIKey is absent from the adult set (201 structures).

name: ChEMBL target profile
doi_or_citation: ChEMBL database. License statement checked 2026-10-19 at https://chembl.gitbook.io/chembl-interface-documentation/about
version: Release number was not recorded in chembl_target_vocab.json. Vocabulary is 15 ChEMBL target IDs chosen by an adult-coverage filter (minimum 5 percent, cap 256) in the prior pipeline.
access_date: verified from the ChEMBL about page on 2026-10-19.
endpoint_definitions: 3057 structure rows; 15 targets; mean missingness 0.924; 38.1 percent of structures have any observed target
domain_definition: Median pChEMBL per target with a missingness indicator. Not Chemical Checker signatures. Not the Tox21 assay labels.
redistribution_status: Features are attached to the same InChIKeys as the trial aggregates. Vocabulary was fit on adult coverage in the prior pipeline and is frozen.
column11: Matrix gitignored. Share-alike would apply if the matrix were redistributed. Not committed.

name: openFDA FAERS
n: with a separate GMDN restriction that does not apply to these drug-event fields.
domain_definition: Prior notebooks pulled 5000 or 25000 pediatric reports and formed 137-compound and 46-compound probes. Those tables are not inputs here.
